thread:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT (P1): metering-ingest-heartbeat-lag detected for prod-us-west. Token counts delayed ~7m, multiple overage flags firing for a subset of customers. Pager: @oncall.
anika: acked. looking into kafka consumers first. :eyes:
sam: I see consumer lag spike on consumer-group=ingest-usw2-01, partition backlog ~120k.
leo: any customer impact visible in billing dashboard yet?
carmen: dashboards show transient overflags for acct_42 and acct_88, customers are not currently billing-locked but alerts firing.
anika: grabbing consumer offsets and recent logs. running:

```
$ kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server x:9092 --describe --group ingest-usw2-01
TOPIC           PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
metering-events 12         840120          960342          120222
```
sam: ok lag confirmed. last consumer restart was 03:42 UTC, but steady lag growth after 03:48.
leo: could be a downstream write throttle. redis or writer DB slowed?
carmen: write times spiking to 2s on metering-writer pod logs.
anika: tailing pod logs:

```
[2026-03-18T03:50:12Z] warn writer: write timeout to billing-db: context deadline exceeded
[2026-03-18T03:51:02Z] error writer: backpressure applied, dropping batch retry
```
sam: temporary mitigation path: 1) enable fallback aggregator (stateless approximate counts) for front-facing reporting 2) pause overage-alerting pipeline (snooze) until we confirm counts land.
leo: agree. remove noisy alerts so customers aren't spammed. we'll still record raw events for reconciliation.
billing-sre: please don't pause customer-facing billing locks. just snooze alerting and notifications, not enforcement.
carmen: starting fallback aggregator config change now. patch:

```
kubectl -n metering set env deployment/aggregator FALLBACK_MODE=true --record
```
anika: applied. aggregator pods rolling, new pods 2/2 ready.
sam: I'm scaling writer pool to 6 to catch up and reducing batch size to 1k to avoid timeouts.

```
kubectl -n metering scale deployment/writer --replicas=6
kubectl -n metering set env deployment/writer BATCH_SIZE=1000
```
leo: scheduler shows writer CPU spikes but steady. consumer lag decreasing from 120k -> 40k in 6m.
carmen: overage-alerting snoozed for 30m (alert-manager silence id: am-silence-7409). notifying support to hold customer outbound comms.
billing-sre: initiated reconciliation job to compare emitted tokens vs ledger snapshot. running low-priority backfill to avoid double-charges.
anika: quick sanity check on emitted counts for acct_42:

```
last_ledger_count: 1,240,180
incoming_buffered: 38,400
expected_after_catchup: 1,278,580
```
sam: good. we should avoid any immediate billing adjustments until backfill completes and reconciliation passes.
leo: are there any other regions affected?
anika: only us-west region for now. routing policy has fallback to us-east if us-west writer can't keep up; I haven't touched routing.
carmen: enforcement: no customer locks, just snooze notifications. support notified in #support (pinged @support-leads). :wave:
billing-sre: OK, I'll monitor reconciliation and mark as 'customer-impact-risk' — will prepare templated comms if counts diverge >1% after catchup.
anika: consumer lag down to 8k and decreasing. writer latency back to ~120ms.
sam: good trend. leave silences active for 20 more minutes, then reevaluate.
leo: creating a short post-incident checklist: root cause (writer DB slow -> backpressure), mitigations (scale writer, reduce batch size, enable fallback aggregator), follow-ups (DB connection pool tuning, circuit-breaker for writer, alert tuning for overflags).
anika: filing follow-up ticket and linking metrics/graphs. ticket: INF-6789.
carmen: support note drafted in #support-digest, holding on outbound comms until reconciliation outcome.
oncall-bot: Incident update: mitigations applied, lag reducing. Monitoring for reversion. Incident will remain open until reconciliation job completes.
billing-sre: Recon job started at 03:58 UTC, ETA 18m. I'll post final status here.
anika: thanks team. :thumbsup:
billing-sre: final: reconciliation complete at 04:16 UTC. No customer invoicing divergence >0.2%. Closing incident and lifting alert silences. Follow-up tasks created: INF-6790 (DB pool tuning), INF-6791 (alert refinement). Incident closed.
